notes.title: Playtest v1.6 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
- Patched broken and incomplete logic on bertie bunny's forest of surprises trigger
- Removed debug text on burger guy's fight
- Fixed a crash on the year dialog from steven
- added in quieter, slower music and some wind ambience in the dark part of the outskirts near the passage to pinewood village
- created logic that handles not defining a positive or negative post turn enemy battle dialog. So far its only tested working with positive undefined
- fixed exiting battle issue where wrong dialog would appear briefly while fading out
- fixed pow and shaking not occurring on final death blow of enemy
- patched Stumpo saying wrong dialog when you crop log barker too much
- added angy log barker sprite
- fixed some broke crit logic in stumpo's mini game due to a incorrectly set damage range value
- Added in enemyTriggers that immediately trigger a fight, with options for random enemies from a pool or not random enemies
- Worked on Bertie Bunny's interaction with the battle system. He can now tell you stuff at the beginning of the battle and end
- Fixed some feather messages, but it may have just broken things.
- Fixed some Bertie Bunny dialogue issues at the end of the forest of surprises
- Added a story beat where the boardwalk breaks, forcing the player to go to the carnival. Carnival has not been worked on yet though
- Fixed combat button issues
- Did some QoL fixes to the graphics when hurting an enemy
- Created new artwork for the game over screen
- Fixed some very broken code for sparing enemies
- Changed some misleading dialogue

KNOWN ISSUES:
- HIGH PRIORITY: when one enemy is spared, the battle ends!! no!!! UGH!
- 90s goblin needs corrected collision and fixed dialogue. quotes dont show up right
- top of mudslide has no music playing
- physics on the pushable boxes in puzzle #2 at the bottom of the mudslide is really weird
- HIGH PRIORITY: if the player tries to run and a fight happened using a physics room and the random game that starts after failing to run is not in the physics room, the game does not set it to the no physics room, breaking some functionality.

notes.title: Playtest v1.5 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
- Polished the mechanics of Dum Fary's game
- Added functionality for enemies to have multiple dialog lines in post turn dialog
- Hopefully plugged up an error causing fights to end in a spare even if you hurt the enemy
- Changed some command box (in combat commands) logic
- Did more work on the Knight Fight. The enemy now only gets hurt after becoming prone after swinging at you
- Added post death dialog for enemy who dies. Not all enemies will have this.
- plugged up some bugs with the Knight Fight stuff not working right on 2nd turn and beyond
- patched a bug allowing the player to talk to the knight when in the battle as if they are still in the overworld
- added Knight 1 death sprite
- Fleshed out the Forest of Surprises with an actual forest. Did not add the surprises yet.
- Continued Bertie Bunny' s story/dialogue, but he is missing a few features still.
TODO: Add a pathing system for bertie bunny in the forest to avoid walking through corners
- Further worked on and refined the Knight Fight. It is still unfinished, but much closer to being finished than before.
- Patched a bug causing player movement freezing on room transition to break in the bickering trees room
- changed the dialogue indicator to only appear in player range
- added many more rooms to have music
- changed up the look of the last room for now
- changed sign text to indicate the correct amount of puzzles in the demo
- cleaned up and made some newer spritework

notes.title: Playtest v1.3 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
- Reformatted the Lake area to close off where the carnival will be
- Added a note item to guide players where to go
- Heavily patched how splitting up dialogue thats too long for its page is handled. It now works very, very well!
- Patched out YYC crashing errors to do with using undefined where noone is a better variable to use
- Patched a bug with re-adding an item that was equiped before is handled
- Patched a bug allowing the player to pick up items not under them
- Created code that allows the player to talk to some items facing south
- added some signs

notes.title: Playtest v1.2 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
- Patched a trigger battle logic issue which broke launching battles after one already happened
- Texture page shenanigans. I discovered an issue that if you mess with textures and dont clean the project, sprites will end up shifted wrong on the shown texture page in-game. So, TIP: Clean the project when you mess with texture pages!
- Patched an unset variable in athena issue
- Removed all debug drawing except for a few
- added in a variable to use to indicate if we're using a dev build or not
 - Patched a rare logic issue causing the game to freeze in an infinite loop when the dialogue system cant find a space and cant break properly
- Patched a bug causing combat dialogue to not reset the combat buttons to selectable when its done being used
- Greatly reduced amount of unnecessary assets
- Fixed Stumpo not playing his own song
- Fixed some YYC compiler errors
- Fixed a broken string on an instructional sign not showing input print when using keyboard
- Fixed instructions on main page to direct players to contact me if they encounter bugs
